title: Roman to Integer
summary: Convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–15 characters from the listed symbols. The numeral is valid and represents a value in [1,3999].
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value. Symbols I, V, X, L, C, D, M stand for 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, and 1000. The valid subtractive pairs are IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, and CM.
constraints: 1–15 characters from the listed symbols. The numeral is valid and represents a value in [1,3999].
hints: Conceptual: Most symbols add their value, but a smaller symbol before a larger one changes sign.
Directional: Compare each symbol with the one immediately after it.
Implementation: Subtract the current value when the next value is larger. Add it otherwise, including the final symbol.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
